English Definition: to leave behind or give up completely
Usage Notes: Often implies leaving without intention to return
记忆法/词根: 前缀a-加强 + bandon(命令)→听任不管
Example (EN): She had to abandon the sinking ship to survive.
例句译文(中文): 为了生还她不得不弃船而逃.

English Definition: to officially end a system or practice
Usage Notes: Used in formal contexts about ending systems
记忆法/词根: 词根abol-离去 + -ish 表动词→取消
Example (EN): The government moved to abolish outdated regulations.
例句译文(中文): 政府决定废除过时的规定.

English Definition: to force someone to leave a country or place
Collocations (EN): banish from the kingdom / banish fear
Example (EN): The traitor was banished after the trial.
例句译文(中文): 那名叛徒审判后被流放。

常用搭配(中文): 无穷的精力/无限的热情
Example (EN): Her boundless curiosity led to many discoveries.
例句译文(中文): 她无穷的好奇心带来了许多发现。

Usage Notes: Often used for harvests or generosity
Example (EN): The region enjoys bountiful rainfall each year.

记忆法/词根: cand-白、光→像光一样明亮坦白
Example (EN): He gave a candid account of the incident.
例句译文(中文): 他坦率地讲述了那件事。

English Definition: the quality of being open and honest
常用搭配(中文): 谈话中的坦率/令人钦佩的坦诚
Example (EN): Her candor won the trust of the audience.
例句译文(中文): 她的坦率赢得了观众的信任。

English Definition: a small waterfall; to fall like a waterfall
Usage Notes: Can be used figuratively for information flow
Example (EN): The news cascaded through social media.
例句译文(中文): 消息在社交媒体上像瀑布般涌现。

常用搭配(中文): 严厉训斥学生/惩治腐败
Example (EN): The manager castigated the team for missing the deadline.
例句译文(中文): 经理因团队错过截止日期而严厉斥责。

English Definition: a person injured or killed in an accident or war
Usage Notes: Common in reports about accidents and wars
记忆法/词根: cas-落下 + -ual-形容词后缀 + -ty 名词
例句译文(中文): 这场风暴造成了许多伤亡。
